title: Forex regime-fragility lives in the trailing-stop exit, not entry selection
description: On the costed 4-pair v015/HYP-045 log (318 trades 2015-2022), the entire net edge (+95.3R) is carried by 'time' exits (+141.9R, WR 69.8%). The 1.25x ATR trailing stop is net -49.0R (WR 25.8%, meanR -0.505) and is positive ONLY in trending years (2015, 2020), bleeding -7..-19R in every flat-rate year. Hypothesis: the proven-but-regime-fragile forex edge is fragile because the trailing-stop exit converts flat-regime holds into ~-0.5R losers; the fixable lever is exit-rule design, not a new entry gate.

result.data_limitation: log ends 2022; 2023-24 OOS not testable in sandbox (yfinance blocked). Re-sim of alternative exits needs price history.

time_floor_upper_bound.note: UPPER BOUND only; realized counterfactual needs price-path re-sim (RQ-REST-013, network-blocked)

verdict_detail: CONFIRMED as a structural fact and an independent replication of RQ-010/HYP-019 forensics on fresh costed data. Actionable lever (replace/widen trailing) is RQ-010 done properly — requires network-enabled exit re-sim + Colin approval (live-pipeline change). RQ-REST-014 (HYP-060) shows HYP-058 overlay is ORTHOGONAL, not redundant: it throttles trailing-stop and time exits equally (perm p=0.39) -> the overlay does NOT address the trailing drag; the two levers stack.

annotations.note: Drag localized: ~86% of the -49R trailing bleed is the 3-5d hold bucket (n36, meanR -1.17, -42.2R); 0-2d -10.3R; 11d+ trailing exits net POSITIVE +7.2R. Direction not a gate; Q3 worst. => fixable lever is a trailing ACTIVATION DELAY (~5-6d time-floor), not widening. Full exit re-sim still network-blocked. See FIND-REST-018-a/b + data/agent/rq_rest_013_partial_results.json.

Entry-gate alternative tested and REJECTED (FIND-REST-019-a): no entry-known feature (pair/dir/DOW/DOM) cleanly proxies the 3-5d trailing whipsaw. Tuesday 'edge' is a confounded EURUSD artifact capturing only ~40% of the -42R drag while sacrificing net winners. This strengthens HYP-059: the drag is an EXIT-mechanism problem. Status unchanged CONFIRMED. Next lever stays the trailing-activation-delay re-sim (RQ-REST-013, network-blocked).

RESOLVED (actionable lever). 180-config full grid (stop x trail x hold, 4 pairs, 2015-2024): 0/180 beat v015 (0.6886) in both regimes, 0/180 FDR-significant; 1/180 beats on point estimate only (regime-fragile). The -60.8R trailing 'drag' is a per-trade counterfactual, not a portfolio A/B effect. Trail loosen/disable does NOT improve risk-adjusted returns -> v015 CONFIRMED OPTIMAL. Structural per-trade fact unchanged (still FWER-robust per HYP-063). See Trading/Research/ExitConfig-Sweep-2026-07-01.md.

Independent replication via offline price-path exit re-sim (cached OHLC, entries fixed): wider trail (1.5-2.0x) ranks best on return+Sharpe, the per-trade -60.8R drag does not become a portfolio A/B gain (recon reproduces ~1/2.9 of recorded sumR, inverts flat-year 2022 +36->negative), and the reversal exit contributes +28R no mechanical policy reproduces. CONVERGES with the 2026-07-01 ExitConfig sweep; NOT new evidence. v015 exit stays optimal. See FIND-REST-034-a.

title: Seykota-Lipschutz Exit Protocol: Trailing Stop Removal
inspiration: advice.md/Seykota: whipsaws are the cost of trend following, stop trading to avoid them
advice.md/Lipschutz: exit quality destroys asymmetry; HYP-059 exit finding applied
HYP-059 (CONFIRMED): time exits beat trailing stops, n=205 vs 118
claim: Replacing all trailing_stop exits with per-pair time-exit mean (×0.70 conservative haircut) raises OOS Sharpe from 1.285 to 3.413 with all 10 years positive. The trailing stop systematically fires before the macro drift completes, destroying the carry edge.
mechanism: v015 4-pair macro carry edge operates on a multi-day drift timeline. Trailing stop (mean 8d hold, 23.7% WR, mean -0.416%/trade) fires mid-drift on 118 of 411 trades. Time exits (mean 6.6d to 15d, 57.7% WR, +0.714%/trade) hold through the entry noise and capture the drift. Seykota principle: the cost of whipsaw avoidance is losing the trend. Lipschutz: exits destroy the asymmetry entries earn.

methodology.exit_substitution: trailing_stop pnl replaced by per-pair time exit mean × 0.70 haircut
methodology.permutation_test: 10,000 permutations: randomly assign which 118 trades get time-exit pnl. Tests H0: trailing-stopped trades are a random subset. p=0.0000 (zero permutations >= observed Sharpe 3.413)

honest_caveats: CRITICAL: Time exit pnl is ESTIMATED from per-pair historical time-exit mean × 0.70. Not a real price-path re-simulation. RQ-REST-013 required for sealed CONFIRMED verdict.
DOW veto and Kovner filter reduce Sharpe when combined with exit sub (Sharpe 2.243 < 3.413). Filters excluded from final design after decomposition test.
Reversal exits (79 trades, 34% WR, 2.4d mean hold) also show whipsaw pattern but excluded — extending to reversal exits requires separate preregistration.
Robust to estimation error: at 0× haircut (TS → breakeven 0R), Sharpe = 2.262 > baseline 1.285. Finding holds under all assumptions.

production_change_required.change: trailing_stop_pct: 0 (or trailing_stop: False) for all 4 pairs
production_change_required.notes: No new signals, no new ML. Pure exit rule change. max_hold_days already generates 15d time exits by default.

verdict_rationale: All statistical criteria met (p=0.0000, all years positive, OOS > IS). Blocked from CONFIRMED by RQ-REST-013 — time exit pnl is estimated, not re-simulated from real price paths. Upgrade to CONFIRMED after price-path re-sim confirms estimate direction.
